source: Tafsir al-Qurtubi, Aisha Abdarrahman Bewley translation, Diwan Press; four-volume English set inspected via Archive.org secondary scan
sanitization_required: exclude running headers/footers and tables of contents from commentary
do not use Archive OCR as final wording authority
quran_text_rule: Do not replace Quran Safeguard's Hafs Mushaf with the Warsh 'an Nafi' Arabic printed in the Bewley source edition.
translation_notice: The translator acknowledges minor omissions and occasional shortening of grammatical/tangential material.
release_note: The runtime/data architecture is implemented, but the Qurtubi payload remains ready_for_distribution=false. No full copyrighted Qurtubi text has been committed by this branch.
